question: Does the frozen Grade-A full40 native-1280 detector emit a causal LONG candidate on FIL-USDT-SWAP 1h during the latest five complete days, near the Owner's profitable descending-trendline-breakout trade?

owner_authorization.verbatim: 你先用模型跑一下filusdt.p 1h周期的 最近5天的数据 我看一下我手动开的盈利的这单能正常识别出来吗
owner_authorization.interpreted_action: Read the current OKX FIL-USDT-SWAP 1h holdout, score every fully closed hourly endpoint in the latest 120-bar interval with the unchanged frozen checkpoint and gates, and deliver causal model inputs plus separated review context. No training, tuning, promotion, deployment, messaging, or order action is authorized.

scope.endpoint_policy: the latest 120 fully closed hourly bars at run freeze time
scope.review_future_policy: for each historical detection, show every later frozen bar through the run tip; these bars are physically absent from model_inputs

reference_screenshot.interpretation_limit: The screenshot shows the setup and a manually drawn descending line but no machine-readable entry marker. The run can establish model detections and their availability times, but cannot prove execution identity without the Owner's entry timestamp or price.

semantic_gate.policy: unchanged frozen causal morphology gate; actual and direction-flipped decisions both retained

single_variable: Relative to the checkpoint's already-consumed 1h latest-endpoint probe #14, this Owner-requested diagnostic fixes the universe to FIL-USDT-SWAP and extends the endpoint range from one closed bar to the latest 120 closed bars. Model bytes, image renderer, W18/W19, thresholds, box mapping, semantic gate, and event spacing remain unchanged. This is a targeted detection replay, not a comparative performance claim.

null_control.method: For every structurally accepted YOLO box, keep pixels, box, confidence, endpoint and all OHLC fixed, and invert only LONG/SHORT inside the causal semantic calculation.
null_control.interpretation: This tests whether any semantic survival is tied to the predicted direction; it does not estimate trading profitability from one Owner-selected winner.

decision_contract.raw_box: reported whenever YOLO confidence is at least 0.25 before structural filtering
decision_contract.structural_candidate: reported only after frozen core4/5 and confirmation2-9 mapping
decision_contract.pipeline_candidate: reported only after the unchanged causal semantic gate passes
decision_contract.recognition_answer: normal full-pipeline recognition requires at least one dense_long pipeline event whose complete availability time falls inside the frozen five-day interval; exact identity with the Owner trade remains unresolved when entry timestamp and price are absent
